crossRefs.note: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy…

translations.web: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,
translations.bsb: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,
translations.kjv: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
translations.asv: or with any stone, whereby a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;
